messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: High crashloop rate detected in runtime-gpu-pool-us-west-2a. 30% of trt-llm containers restarting with SIGSEGV. Paging oncall. :rotating_light:

sre_alice: Got it, oncall here. Looking at alerts and pod restarts now. Any immediate customer-facing errors?

customer_ops_ela: We're seeing 12 customers with increased 5xxs, one customer (acct-888) is P0. They're hitting latency spikes then errors. Notified support to surface status page.

runtime_carla: Stack traces from k8s logs show segfaults in fused_attention_cuda.so right after kernel launch. Repro on one node that has two GPUs with device-affinity pinned.

eng_bob: Correlated with recent node reprovisioning—nvml reports intermittent GPU detach on index 1. Node kubelet logs show: 
```
E0321 03:12:10 kubelet.go:123] device plugin error: nvml: GPU 0000:65:00.0: unavailable
Segfault: fused_attention_cuda::launch(...) +0x1f3
```

runtime_carla: This smells like a race between our affinity mask and TensorRT fused kernels assuming stable device handles. If a GPU toggles, we can hit NULL deref in native code.

sre_alice: Immediate mitigation: cordon + drain the node to stop restarts and reduce customer impact. Then scale up another node pool to absorb traffic. I can cordon now unless objections.

oncall_dave: I'm running cordon + graceful drain for node/gpu-node-12. Command: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-12 && kubectl drain gpu-node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force`

runtime_carla: Good. Also push a runtime env to disable fused kernels until we debug: `RT_FUSED_KERNELS=0` (runtime will fall back to safe kernel path). That will degrade perf ~15% but avoid crashes. We should rollout this as a patch to the affected deployment set (trt-llm).

deploy-bot: Started rollout: trt-llm@stable -> trt-llm@safe-fallback (env RT_FUSED_KERNELS=0). Canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%.

eng_bob: While drain happens, capture core dumps from one crashed pod for offline analysis. Steps: 
1) `kubectl exec -n infra <pod> -- ls -la /var/lib/cores`
2) `kubectl cp <pod>:/var/lib/cores/core.<pid> ./`
3) `gdb /opt/runtime/bin/engine ./core.<pid> -ex 'thread apply all bt' -ex quit`
Upload to s3://redwood-private/incident-3187654321/ for eng.

runtime_carla: I'll take the core. Preliminary `bt` shows: 
```
#0  0x00007f4b2a3c1f3a in fused_attention_cuda::compute(...)
#1  0x00007f4b2a3b9ea1 in trt::execute_batch(...)
#2  0x0000561f8bb0a2c3 in runtime::serve_request(...)
```
Looks like NULL stream/handle when GPU disappears.

sre_alice: Customer impact mitigation: enable fallback model routing for the affected routes (route -> cpu-small or hosted-llm). Can customer_ops toggle routing for acct-888?

customer_ops_ela: Yes, we can route acct-888 to hosted-llm-1 for the next 3 hours. Doing that now.

runtime_carla: Longer term: add guard in CUDA plugin to re-query NVML on launch and refuse fused kernel if device state unstable. Also add exponential backoff on device handle reopen to avoid crash loops. I'll create a PR after we stabilize.

eng_bob: Also look at node reprovisioning job that recently set `--gpu-affinity=pack` on kube feature gate. Rolling that back for the pool if it correlates.

deploy-bot: Rollout to 100% complete. trt-llm safe-fallback is live across affected ASG.

sre_alice: Node drained and cordoned. New nodes healthy, traffic shifted. Crashloop count dropped to 0/last 10m. Monitoring team to keep 5m checks for next 2 hours.

runtime_carla: Collected cores and uploaded tarball to s3://redwood-private/incident-3187654321/cores.tar.gz. Gists with stripped bt: https://internal.redwood/gists/3187654321. Assigning to eng-runtime for root cause.

eng_bob: Filing post-incident follow-up: root cause hypothesis: device affinity + NVML transient detach + fused kernel assumption -> NULL deref. Action items: 
- Hotfix: guard + disable fused on flaky nodes (carla)
- Infra: rollback affinity flag for pool (bob)
- Observe: add NVML flapping alert (sre_alice)

sre_alice: Handoff: I will be primary for the next 2 hours, then hand to eng-oncall @sre_tom. Leaving notes in incident doc. :white_check_mark:

customer_ops_ela: Support updated status page and customers. One P0 acknowledged fallback routing. Will follow up postmortem.

incident-bot: INCIDENT created: INC-2026-3187654321. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/rt-segfaults. Pager silence applied for 30m.

sre_alice: Thanks team — keeping this thread brief. Will update if we see regression.
